stanza: I can't believe that the axis turns on suffering
When you taste so good
I can't believe that the axis turns on suffering
When my headache burns

burns.line: Spinnin' Teddy Pendergrass vinyl as my J burns
burns.lineNext: I shed a tear before the night's over

returns.line: Spiders are filling out tax returns
stanza: Spiders are singing in the salty breeze
Spiders are filling out tax returns
Spinning out webs of deductions and melodies
On a private beach in Michigan
And in this constant coming back to life
A flickering spark jumps sharp in my eye
I scan the horizon from this spot where I stand
Nothing returns
I give this and the next and the next and all the following
Breaths!

turns.line: She speaks a word and it gently turns
stanza: She speaks a word and it gently turns
To perfect metaphor
She likes to say I only play
When I know what I'm playing for
And all that we built
And all that we breathed
And all that we spilt, or pulled up like weeds
Is piled up in back;
And it burns irrevocably
(And we spoke up in turns
'Till the silence crept over me)

turns.line: Don't read in too much to all the signs and turns
stanza: If you should be bored in California
I'm sure I'm not the first to warn ya
Don't read in too much to all the signs and turns
Keep your wits about you and your mind freedom
My body turns and yearns
For a sleep that won't ever come
